mapper.select: SELECT t.*, tp.payments_id FROM tour.tickets t JOIN tour.ticket_payments tp ON tp.tickets_id = t.id JOIN public.payments p ON tp.payments_id = p.id WHERE p.invoice_no = #{invoiceNo}
SELECT * FROM tour.ticket_payments WHERE tickets_id = ( SELECT tp.tickets_id FROM public.payments p JOIN tour.ticket_payments tp ON tp.payments_id = p.id WHERE p.invoice_no = #{invoiceNo} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tour.ticket_payments WHERE tickets_id = ( SELECT tp.tickets_id FROM public.payments p JOIN tour.ticket_payments tp ON tp.payments_id = p.id WHERE p.invoice_no = #{invoiceNo} )
mapper.select: INSERT INTO tour.tickets ( packages_id, ticket_amount, users_id ) VALUES ( #{data.packagesId}, #{data.ticketAmount}, (SELECT id FROM auth.users u WHERE u.email = #{email}) ) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tour.ticket_payments ( tickets_id, payments_id ) VALUES ( #{ticketsId}, (SELECT id FROM public.payments WHERE invoice_no = #{invoiceNo}) )
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, tp.payments_id FROM tour.tickets t JOIN tour.ticket_payments tp ON tp.tickets_id = t.id WHERE users_id = (SELECT id FROM auth.users u WHERE u.email = #{email})
SELECT f.* FROM tour.ticket_files tf JOIN public.files f ON tf.files_id = f.id WHERE tf.tickets_id = #{id}
